articles.title: South Korea's Kosdaq has lost almost half its value since April
articles.easyKo: 코스닥 지수가 4월 고점에서 거의 절반이 빠졌어요. 월요일에는 638.97로 마감했고, 코스피보다 두 배 가까이 더 떨어졌어요. 큰 종목뿐 아니라 많은 종목이 올해 최저가를 찍었어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's Kosdaq index has lost almost half its value since April. On Monday it closed at 638.97, down 0.82 percent on the day. That is 47.9 percent below its high of 1,226.18 on April 27.

articles.title: Samsung and LG hire robotics experts abroad as they push robots toward real products
articles.easyKo: 삼성전자와 LG전자가 일본과 미국에서 로봇 전문가를 뽑는 채용 공고를 냈어요. 삼성은 로봇 손과 센서 쪽을, LG는 로봇 부품을 파는 영업과 물리 AI 연구 쪽을 찾고 있어요. 두 회사가 로봇을 실제 사업으로 만들려는 모습을 보여 줘요.

paragraphs.en: Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics are hiring robotics experts abroad. Job postings seen on Sunday show how the two firms plan to turn robot ideas into real products.

articles.title: South Korea's presidential office starts a "Paycheck Defense Squad" to help workers keep more pay

articles.title: EU Draft Law Would Fine Apps That Use Tricky Design Up to 6% of Sales

paragraphs.en: A draft law from the European Commission would punish companies that use unfair digital tricks. Firms found guilty could face fines of up to 6% of their annual global turnover, according to a draft seen by Reuters. Justice chief Michael McGrath will present the proposal, called the Digital Fairness Act, on Wednesday.

paragraphs.en: The draft would ban "dark patterns", which are website and app designs that push people to buy more. It would also ban personalized ads that target children or vulnerable consumers. Sellers that change ticket prices with real-time demand would have to be more open. They would have to show how many items are available at the advertised price.

articles.title: A Robot Builds Part of a Structure in Space Without Astronauts
articles.easyKo: 미국 캘리포니아공대 로봇이 우주에서 사람 없이 구조물 일부를 처음으로 조립했어요. 로켓에 다 들어가지 않는 큰 망원경이나 안테나를 우주에서 만들 길을 열 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: A robot has built part of a structure in space without help from astronauts. It was made by researchers at the California Institute of Technology, or Caltech. DARPA, a US defense research agency, says it is the first automated assembly of a structure in space.

sents.ko: 미국 국방 연구기관 DARPA는 우주에서 구조물을 자동으로 조립한 첫 사례라고 말해요.

paragraphs.en: The robot takes tubes and joints from nearby storage boxes. It joins them into repeating sections called bays. Together, the bays form a frame called a truss.
